LIC-002.name: Exam Scheduled & Reminder
LIC-002.structure: Dual trigger (tag lic-exam-scheduled OR Contact Changed on Exam Date) -> If/Else 'Exam Date Set?' -> Yes: Confirmation Email -> Wait 3 days -> 72h Reminder SMS -> Wait 1 day -> 24h Reminder SMS -> Wait until exam date -> Exam Day SMS -> Wait 4h -> Post-Exam Outcome Request SMS -> END. No: END.
LIC-002.recommendedFix: Add an If/Else gate immediately before each of the 4 remaining send steps (72h, 24h, Exam Day, Post-Exam) checking 'Outcome field is empty'; route to END if not empty instead of sending. Reuses the If/Else pattern already proven in this workflow - no native Goal/exit-condition feature needed.
LIC-002.fixStatus: recommended by CRO review 2026-09-07, not yet confirmed applied

platformGaps.title: No staff/users configured
platformGaps.impact: Every Create Task / Assign User step is unavailable
platformGaps.workaround: Substitute an Internal Notification (Type=Notification, To User Type=All users, Redirect Page=Contact)
platformGaps.upgradePath: Convert to real assigned tasks once staff are added in Settings > My Staff

platformGaps.title: No calendars configured
platformGaps.impact: Any workflow with a 'Customer booked appointment' trigger can't set calendar filters
platformGaps.upgradePath: Add calendar filters once calendars are created

platformGaps.title: No native Filter action or custom-object-change trigger
platformGaps.impact: Cannot filter mid-workflow on arbitrary object changes
platformGaps.workaround: Use If/Else gates and tag-based conditions instead

platformGaps.title: No native 'Custom Field Changed' trigger
platformGaps.impact: Cannot trigger directly off a specific custom field update
platformGaps.workaround: Use the 'Contact changed' trigger (search 'changed', not 'custom field', in the trigger picker), filtered to the specific field

platformGaps.title: Wait action 'hours' field caps/misbehaves above 23
platformGaps.workaround: Use the 'days' field for exact offsets (3 days = 72h, 1 day = 24h)

platformGaps.title: No native Goal or field-based exit condition on a running workflow
platformGaps.impact: Cannot cleanly exit a reminder sequence once an outcome field (e.g. Pass/Fail) updates mid-sequence; 'Stop on response' exits on any reply, not a specific field, and breaks reminder cadence
platformGaps.workaround: recommendedFix in LIC-002 entry above: per-step If/Else gate checking the outcome field before each send
platformGaps.status: open - recommendation given, not yet confirmed applied by the build session

platformGaps.title: Missing custom fields must be created directly in the data model
platformGaps.impact: A tag/text workaround isn't viable for typed values like dates
platformGaps.workaround: Create the real typed field via Settings > Custom Fields when a workflow structurally requires it (e.g. 'Exam Date' as a Date-picker field on Contact)
